title: Cursed Crafting
description: Every crafting recipe gives a completely different item. So while you can mine everything the game decides what they will craft into!
body:
# Cursed Crafting

Every crafting recipe in Minecraft has been cursed.

Whenever you craft an item, the result is replaced with a completely different item. A wooden pickaxe might become a Totem of Undying, an Eye of Ender, a Netherite tool, or almost anything else in the game.

The twist is that the curse is consistent within a world. Once a recipe is assigned a cursed result, it will always produce that same result for that world. Start a new world and the entire crafting system is shuffled again.

### Features

* Every recipe produces a different item.
* Consistent recipe mapping within the same world.
* New randomized crafting progression in every world.
* Works with both the crafting table and the player crafting grid.
* What you see in the output slot is exactly what you receive.

### Notes

* The `/findcurse` command may be present in some versions of the mod. It was an unfinished debugging feature and is currently non-functional. It is not intended for normal gameplay.
* Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.3 or newer.

Can you beat Minecraft when every recipe has been cursed?
